levels.name: Flower of Eden
levels.description: Transient Blossoms generated by Albedo's Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma regenerate 1.2 Energy for Albedo.

levels.name: Opening of Phanerozoic
levels.description: Transient Blossoms generated by Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma grant Albedo Fatal Reckoning for 30s: Unleashing Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide consumes all stacks of Fatal Reckoning. Each stack of Fatal Reckoning consumed increases the DMG dealt by Fatal Blossoms and Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide's burst DMG by 30% of Albedo's DEF. This effect stacks up to 4 times.

levels.name: Grace of Helios
levels.description: Increases the Level of Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Descent of Divinity
levels.description: Active party members within the Solar Isotoma field have their Plunging Attack DMG increased by 30%.

levels.name: Tide of Hadean
levels.description: Increases the Level of Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Dust of Purification
levels.description: Active party members within the Solar Isotoma field who are protected by a shield created by Crystallize have their DMG increased by 17%.
